shipped.title: Omaweb · Yab feature parity, Chrome profiles and extensions
shipped.summary: Merged the pull request that brings Omaweb up to the feature set of upstream Yab on Linux: pinned favorites, Spaces, folders, auto-archive, split view, Peek, an agent chat panel, a settings screen and a library, plus separate Chrome-style profiles with a Chrome importer and extension support through Qt WebEngine.
bullets: Extension status documented honestly in the pull request
